icons.license: Offered for download on Aero's brand page, which states no terms
icons.layout: The #F1F1F1 full-disc path becomes the disc in the same paint; the six pinwheel paths are scaled from 1080 to 64 units and otherwise unchanged. The source draws no filter, mask or blend mode; its one clip-path covers the whole canvas and is dropped.
icons.coresvg_check: NSImage (CoreSVG) renders of icons/crypto/aero.svg and the source SVG at 512 px differ by at most 8 of 255 in any channel (no pixel above 8); at 64 px, 2 of 4096 pixels exceed 8 (max 11). icons/crypto/aero.svg is unchanged by scripts/svgo.config.mjs with makeArcs on or off.
icons.replaces: aerodrome (the legacy Aerodrome AERO mark), removed with the legacy token
